university.name: University of Leeds
university.summary: Large research university in Leeds, West Yorkshire, teaching undergraduate, taught master's and research degrees across business, law, engineering, computing, science, arts and social sciences. It publishes a Pakistan page with postgraduate grade equivalences and runs an International Foundation Year.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor (gov.uk register dated 2026-10-07): University of Leeds, Leeds, Higher Education Institution (HEI), Student Sponsor, Track Record, Student route.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.overview: Three-year degree covering programming, computer systems and architecture, theoretical foundations and software engineering in the first year. UCAS code G400.
highlights: Theoretical Foundations of Computer Science I
courses.academic_requirements: A levels AAA including Mathematics; IB 18 points at Higher Level including 5 in HL Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches or 6 in HL Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation. GCSE English Language at grade C (4) or above.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall, with no less than 5.5 in each section.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Leeds' Pakistan page lists, for undergraduate entry, completion of a foundation programme such as the Leeds International Foundation Year, or other level 3 qualifications such as A levels or the IB. It gives no percentage thresholds for undergraduate entry.
courses.career_notes: The course page says graduates are sought after for their technical knowledge.
courses.notes: The page returned shows a September 2025 start and the 2025/26 international fee, not 2027 entry: target year fee not yet published or not visible. The 'Year of entry' field was blank. Fee, entry grades and English scores must be rechecked on the live page before publication.

courses.title: Law
courses.overview: Three-year qualifying law degree with first-year modules in contract law, criminal law, foundations of law and legal skills. UCAS code M100.
courses.academic_requirements: A levels A*AA with specific subject requirements; two A levels must be in traditional academic subjects. IB 36 overall (6,6,6 at Higher Level). A substantial number of GCSE passes at a high standard expected.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, with no less than 6.0 in any component.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Leeds' Pakistan page lists, for undergraduate entry, completion of a foundation programme such as the Leeds International Foundation Year, or other level 3 qualifications such as A levels or the IB. It gives no percentage thresholds for undergraduate entry.
courses.career_notes: The course page names law firms, in-house legal teams and barristers' chambers, as well as business, government, education, the third sector and finance, among graduate destinations.
courses.notes: The page returned is headed '2024 course information' with a September 2025 start. The page does not say which academic year the GBP 26,250 fee applies to, so tuition_academic_year is null. Target year fee not yet published or not visible. No admissions test was mentioned on the page.

courses.title: Business Analytics and Decision Sciences
courses.overview: Twelve-month taught master's applying quantitative methods to management decisions, with compulsory modules on decision making, decision science and forecasting. Applicants need a sound grounding in quantitative subjects.
courses.academic_requirements: Bachelor degree with a 2:1 (hons) in a related subject, with a sound grounding in quantitative subjects.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, with no less than 6.0 in any component.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Leeds' Pakistan page gives postgraduate equivalences: where a 2:1 is asked for, 70 per cent or a GPA of 2.8 to 3.0 (the GPA scale is not stated); entry from a 4 year Bachelor, or a 2 year Masters if the Bachelor is shorter than 4 years.
courses.career_notes: The course page lists analytics and decision-making roles, management roles and business or market analyst roles, and names several employers of recent graduates.
courses.notes: The page returned shows 'Year of entry 2024' and a September 2024 start; the GBP 30,250 total is that year's fee. Target year fee not yet published or not visible. The pk_route mapping of '4 year Bachelor' to bachelor_16 is our reading of the Pakistan page wording.

courses.title: Management
courses.overview: Twelve-month general management master's open to graduates of any subject, with compulsory modules on strategic management, management in practice, operations and supply chain, and organisational behaviour.
courses.academic_requirements: Bachelor degree with a 2:1 (hons) in any subject.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, with no less than 6.0 in each component.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Leeds' Pakistan page gives postgraduate equivalences: where a 2:1 is asked for, 70 per cent or a GPA of 2.8 to 3.0 (the GPA scale is not stated); entry from a 4 year Bachelor, or a 2 year Masters if the Bachelor is shorter than 4 years.
courses.notes: The page returned had a blank 'Year of entry' heading and a September 2024 start, so the 2024/25 year is inferred from the start date. Target year fee not yet published or not visible.

courses.title: Data Science and Analytics
courses.overview: Twelve-month master's in data science with compulsory modules in data science and case-study skills, a 60-credit dissertation, and optional modules such as machine learning. Needs a strong mathematics, statistics or computing background.
highlights: Dissertation in Data Science and Analytics
courses.academic_requirements: Bachelor degree with a first or high 2:1 (hons) in a subject with a substantial maths, statistics and/or computing component; key modules should mostly be firsts, with none below a 2:1.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, with no component below 6.0.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Leeds' Pakistan page gives postgraduate equivalences: first is 80 per cent or a GPA of 3.1 to 3.5, 2:1 is 70 per cent or a GPA of 2.8 to 3.0 (the GPA scale is not stated). This course asks for a first or high 2:1, so no single threshold is recorded.
courses.notes: The page returned shows 2024 entry with a September 2024 start; target year fee not yet published or not visible. uk_min_degree_class recorded as 2:1 although the page says first or high 2:1.

courses.title: Economics
courses.overview: Twelve-month master's with compulsory modules in macroeconomics, microeconomics and econometrics. Applicants need a background in economics and a strong grounding in quantitative subjects.
courses.academic_requirements: Bachelor degree with a 2:1 (hons) with a background in economics; a strong grounding in quantitative subjects with high grades is essential.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, with no less than 6.0 in any component.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Leeds' Pakistan page gives postgraduate equivalences: where a 2:1 is asked for, 70 per cent or a GPA of 2.8 to 3.0 (the GPA scale is not stated); entry from a 4 year Bachelor, or a 2 year Masters if the Bachelor is shorter than 4 years.
courses.career_notes: The course page lists economic adviser, think-tank researcher, financial director and quantitative analyst roles, and further academic study, among graduate paths.
courses.notes: The page returned shows a September 2026 start and a blank 'Year of entry' field. The page does not state the fee year, so 2026/27 is inferred from the start date. This is still not the 2027 entry fee: target year fee not yet published or not visible.

scholarships.name: International Excellence Scholarship (undergraduate)
scholarships.value_text: Up to 250 awards worth GBP 3,000, GBP 6,000 or GBP 16,000 off first-year tuition (September 2026 terms)
scholarships.summary: First-year tuition discount for international undergraduates holding an offer, awarded on academic record, extracurricular activity and a short application. Terms below are those published for September 2026 entry.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee status; self-funded or partly funded; conditional or unconditional offer for an eligible undergraduate course entering Year 1; excellent academic record and extracurricular activities; MBChB and BChD excluded; separate application for each course offer.
scholarships.deadline_note: For September 2026 entry applications closed on Tuesday 31 March at 5pm BST, with outcomes by Friday 15 May. 2027 entry dates not seen.
scholarships.notes: Terms are for September 2026 entry. The page does not name Pakistan, but eligibility is any international fee-paying student. Recheck all values and dates for 2027 entry before publishing.
